label: AEP / Looma (Host-native retrieval route)
route_note: The application declares no retrieval route at all: a semantic task boundary, a Result Contract, and a deterministic step(validate_result) gate. The Host owns the reachable action set, so the same command and the same file satisfy both batches.
widening_note: There is no widened variant. Widening is a Host-side act that costs the application zero SLOC.
fixture_mode_note: host_driver.py only simulates the external Host for deterministic CI and is excluded from application LOC; the Host tool trace is written to <output>.host.json.
